goal: Resolve truncated, alias, and description mentions into runtime canonical entities well enough that the qualified structural selector can operate on surface tasks.

motivation.observed_defect: S2b and S2c are inert on descv4_surface: differs_from_s0=0.00 on every task, because entity extraction yields no question entity on 100/100 tasks. Subjects are truncated ('Ojos tension' vs canonical 'Ojos tension block').
motivation.why_this_gate_and_not_more_selector_work: The surface partition has MORE selector headroom than the ID partition (+0.550 vs +0.390), but the structural selector cannot access it because chains cannot be anchored to the question entity. The missing operation is identity resolution, not model scale or reranking capacity.

ladder.I0_current_surface_anchor_extraction: baseline; the mechanism that is currently inert
ladder.I2_prefix_suffix_tolerant_resolution: allow a mention to match a longer canonical form when the extension is a plausible entity-type continuation
ladder.I3_alias_identity_record_retrieval: retrieve identity records that state the mapping
ladder.I4_bounded_canonicalization_through_retr: follow refers_to edges found at runtime, bounded depth
ladder.I5_oracle_identity_resolution_plus_real_: perfect anchoring, real selection: isolates resolution from selection

primary_metric.name: S2cLiveRate
primary_metric.definition: fraction of tasks on which S2c can construct at least one nontrivial chain

reader_policy.rationale: Resolution is measurable without the reader; adding generation first would confound resolution failure with reader error and cost hours per iteration.

mechanism_constraints.deterministic_before_learned: Deterministic runtime normalization must be tried and measured before any learned resolver.
mechanism_constraints.no_hardcoded_entity_vocabulary: The V4 entity-type vocabulary must NOT be hardcoded. Only generic mention-compatibility features are permitted.
permitted_features: alias / refers_to links already present in evidence
mechanism_constraints.no_oracle_metadata_at_runtime: _oracle_metadata remains evaluator-only; resolution must use question text and candidate text only.

generalization_requirement.rationale: Tuning a resolver on descv4_surface would build a second surface-specific shortcut, which is the failure already recorded for the relation-keyword arm.

success_criteria.runtime_purity: no oracle metadata available at runtime
success_criteria.stretch_result: surface S2c captures 20-30% of the surface S5 gap (+0.550)

holdout_policy.note: The reserved holdout must not participate in resolver choice, threshold calibration, feature selection, or debugging.

explicitly_out_of_scope: the anchor-found / anchor-missing routing policy, which must not be implemented until identity resolution is itself qualified
larger rerankers or additional model capacity
